items.t: Delta zoning — number CONTESTED, flagged, not settled: City pages cite "Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, 2017" (the bylaw whose s. What is not contested: zoning is parcel by parcel on the City zoning maps; the Beach Grove waterfront zone sheet RD2 states a 4,000 m² subdivision minimum for waterfront lots in Beach Grove.

Waterfront setback and Hazard DPA SD3: zoning s. 6.2.3 sets a waterfront setback for lots fronting on Boundary Bay along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue, under which a seawall may encroach into the minimum front setback, and the bylaw states no Beach Grove flood construction level; Hazard DPA SD3 (Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands), OCP Bylaw No. 8400 Appendix B, provides no building with the underside of a wooden floor system or the top of a concrete slab for habitable areas lower than 2.9 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, minimum land surface elevation around construction 2.3 metres GSC datum, and no building within 7.5 metres of the natural boundary of a tidal area. Whether a specific lot falls inside SD3 is a parcel-level check: UNVERIFIED for any individual lot.

blocks.text: Good to know about Beach Grove Guide

items.t: The "Beach Grove condo" is a corridor product, not a beach product. A buyer searching the page name expecting waterfront condos will not find one.

(2) The Planning section's wording — up to 3 or 4 units "plus a secondary suite and coach or garden suites within the unit limits" — can be read as a suite on top of the 4-unit limit, while the verified City position is up to 4 units on single-detached and duplex lots in total.

The 2.9 m number governs this shore, and the zoning bylaw states no flood construction level of its own. SD3 sets the habitable floor at 2.9 metres GSC datum with a 2.3 m minimum land elevation and a 7.5 m tidal setback; zoning s. 6.2.3 lets a seawall encroach into the minimum front setback on Boundary Bay lots along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue, and states no Beach Grove flood construction level — so the FCL question goes to the permit area and the City, not the zoning text.

The old area-plan name still surfaces in City paperwork. A City report on 1728 Beach Grove Road described the property under the Tsawwassen Area Plan — that plan was Schedule D.1 under the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950; the current OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), consolidated the former area plans into a single Land Use Plan with no lettered schedules, and its designation list does not include "Single Family Residential".

The dike trail is the amenity, and it is a working dike. Boundary Bay Regional Park's Dyke Trail runs on the Boundary Bay dike system the City maintains as flood protection — recreation on top of infrastructure, which is why foreshore work is permitted, not casual.

Health care: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, Delta, in Ladner (Fraser Health), is the nearest hospital, and Fraser Health lists a South Delta After-Hours Urgent and Primary Care Centre serving Tsawwassen at 1826 – 4949 Canoe Pass Way.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Beach Grove Guide

items.t: OCP: Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), adopted July 8, 2024 — consolidated, with NO lettered schedules: The current OCP consolidated the former area plans into a single Land Use Plan and does not use a "Single Family Residential" designation (s. 1.5.1); farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)". Historical framing only: a City report on 1728 Beach Grove Road (report LU009394) described that property as having a Single Family Residential designation in the Tsawwassen Area Plan — that was the former area plan, Schedule D.1 under the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950. Any "Schedule D.1 of Bylaw 8400" attribution is an ERROR wherever it is met.

Waterfront setback: Zoning Bylaw s. 6.2.3 sets a waterfront setback for lots fronting on Boundary Bay along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue, under which a seawall may encroach into the minimum front setback; the bylaw states no Beach Grove flood construction level.

Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 (Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands): OCP Bylaw No. 8400, Appendix B — no building with the underside of a wooden floor system or the top of a concrete slab for habitable areas lower than 2.9 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, minimum land surface elevation around construction 2.3 metres GSC datum, and no building within 7.5 metres of the natural boundary of a tidal area.

Dike and flood system: the Beach Grove shore faces Boundary Bay behind the Boundary Bay dike; Delta is the diking authority and operates and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure.

Strata block — for The Pillars' and the corridor buildings' strata lots (no bare-land strata verified here): Form B (SPA s. 59) within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25¢/page, with rules, current budget and most recent depreciation report attached; depreciation reports every five years for stratas with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (the corridor directory's "rentals not allowed" line for Heron Cove is void for long-term rentals on this rule); only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2, May 1, 2023 exemptions) — no Beach Grove building is verified as 55+; a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid age bylaw.

: where ALR ground exists, subdivision requires Agricultural Land Commission approval and residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within the principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); farm class on the full three-tier test ($2,500 at 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; apply by October 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Beach Grove?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Beach Grove?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Beach Grove?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Beach Grove?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Is there a condo on the Beach Grove waterfront?
faq.a: No verified one. The cross-referenced apartment-condo buildings (Heron Cove, Windgrove, Tsawwassen Mews, The Pillars' apartment component) all stand on the 56 Street / 16 Avenue corridor; the waterfront streets are detached and duplex houses, including RD2 lots the bylaw describes as waterfront lots in Beach Grove.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Heron Cove unit if the directory says rentals are not allowed?
faq.a: Long-term, yes — every BC strata rental-restriction bylaw became void on November 24, 2022, whatever older directory or bylaw text says. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw, so read the current registered bylaws on the Form B package.

faq.q: How many units are in Heron Cove — 52 or 101?
faq.a: Both figures exist and are not reconciled: the building directory records 52 units in the 1704 56th Street building, while the area research records a 101-unit complex total (plan LMS2509) from a strata directory.

faq.q: Is The Pillars a condo building or a townhouse complex?
faq.a: Both, by address: listings record 1700 56 Street units as Townhouse and 1702 56 Street penthouse units as Apartment, in one complex built in 1996. Compare a unit against its own form, and confirm the strata's structure on the Form B.

faq.q: Which elementary school serves a Beach Grove condo?
faq.a: Run the building's exact address in the SD37 locator or against the published Tsawwassen Area catchment maps before writing a school into an offer.

faq.q: Is Beach Grove an official City of Delta neighbourhood?
faq.a: 8400 (2024) — a single consolidated plan with no Beach Grove area-plan schedule in it.

faq.q: Is The Pillars a condo building or a townhouse complex?
faq.a: Both, by address: listings record 1700 56 Street units as Townhouse and 1702 56 Street penthouse units as Apartment, in one complex built in 1996. Price and compare a unit against its own form, and confirm the strata's structure on the Form B.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Beach Grove strata unit long-term?
faq.a: Yes in law — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw; read the registered bylaws.
